name: NASA Fire Event Data Suite (FEDS), VEDA API
what: 12-hourly fire perimeters for the 2020–2021 fires. Method: Chen et al. 2022, Scientific Data, doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01343-0 (California 2012–2020); the VEDA archive extends it.

name: NASA FIRMS VIIRS 375 m active fire archive
what: Satellite fire detections from Suomi NPP and NOAA-20 (VNP14IMG / VJ114IMG).
licence: NASA open data; cite NASA FIRMS

name: NIFC WFIGS Interagency Fire Perimeters
what: Official final perimeters and GIS acres; discovery dates.

name: CAL FIRE incident list
what: All CAL FIRE-listed incidents with reported acres and start dates.
licence: public information published by CAL FIRE (no formal licence stated)

name: AWS Terrain Tiles (Mapzen Terrarium)
what: Elevation from USGS 3DEP/NED and SRTM, resampled.
licence: Open; attribution to USGS and the listed source providers

name: USGS/MRLC National Land Cover Database
what: Pre-fire land cover (NLCD 2019 for 2020–21 fires, NLCD 2021 for later fires).

name: US Census TIGER/Line via TIGERweb
what: Roads, town points with 2020 population and housing units, state outline, county boundaries, and linear hydrography (rivers and creeks) for the Helene flood tab.

name: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API
what: Buildings as mapped the day before ignition (small fires only).

name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5 / ERA5-Land)
what: Hourly wind, gusts, humidity and temperature at each fire; hourly precipitation (ERA5) for Hurricane Helene, 24–29 Sep 2024; daily precipitation, ET0 and temperature (ERA5) and ERA5-Land soil moisture on a 0.5 degree grid for the California drought soil-water model.
licence: data CC BY 4.0, free API for non-commercial use; ERA5 © Copernicus/ECMWF

name: USGS Earthquake Catalog (ComCat)
what: Ridgecrest 2019 earthquakes M2+ with time, depth and magnitude.

name: USGS ShakeMap
what: Shaking intensity (MMI) grids for the M6.4 and M7.1.

name: USGS Quaternary Fault and Fold Database
what: Fault lines near Ridgecrest.

name: US Drought Monitor
what: Weekly drought statistics for California and its 58 counties, 2020–2023.
licence: Public domain; credit: The U.S. Drought Monitor is jointly produced by the National Drought Mitigation Center at UNL, USDA and NOAA

name: IRIS FDSN station web service (CI network)
what: Locations of Southern California Seismic Network stations (HH/HN channels) used for the what-if warning-time map.
licence: Open metadata (EarthScope/IRIS; network CI: Caltech and USGS)

name: USGS Operational Aftershock Forecast product
what: Reasenberg-Jones parameters (a, b, p, c) and observed counts for the Ridgecrest sequence.

name: Nevada Geodetic Laboratory GNSS time series (IGS14, tenv3)
what: Daily GNSS positions near Ridgecrest, used for the ground-motion arrows. Cite: Blewitt, Hammond and Kreemer (2018), GPS Solutions.

name: NOAA National Hurricane Center HURDAT2 best track
what: Track, maximum sustained wind, central pressure, wind radii and radius of maximum wind for Hurricane Helene (AL092024).

name: NOAA/NWS National Water Prediction Service API
what: Official flood categories (action, minor, moderate, major stage) for the gauges on the Helene flood tab.

name: USGS Water Data OGC API (field measurements, monitoring locations)
what: Manual depth-to-water readings (parameter 72019) at California monitoring wells, 2020–2023, with each well's constructed depth and land altitude.

name: California DWR Groundwater Level monitoring wells (GWL Recently Measured)
what: Well depth and perforated (screened) interval for wells that match a USGS well within 150 m.
licence: published openly by California DWR (ArcGIS service); no licence text is stated on the service, so credit DWR

name: NASA GRACE Drought Indicators (GRACE-DA), University of Nebraska-Lincoln / NDMC
what: Weekly groundwater percentile maps (0.125 degree) from a land model that assimilates GRACE and GRACE-FO gravity data; Matthew Rodell, Bailing Li and colleagues at NASA GSFC.
licence: Public; credit NASA GRACE data assimilation, National Drought Mitigation Center at UNL

name: USGS National Water Information System
what: Daily storage of six California reservoirs since 1990 (for the 1991-2020 average by date); 15-minute gage height and discharge at eight western North Carolina gauges during Hurricane Helene; annual peak lists for record context.
licence: US Government public domain (recent data provisional)

name: USDA NRCS SNOTEL, Air and Water Database REST API
what: Daily snow water equivalent and the NRCS daily median at California SNOTEL sites.

name: NOAA Multi-Radar/Multi-Sensor (MRMS) QPE, NOAA Open Data on AWS
what: Hourly radar and gauge rainfall (MultiSensor QPE 1H Pass2) over western North Carolina, 25-30 September 2024.

name: USGS Hurricane Helene Landslide Inventory (preliminary)
what: Mapped landslide points and their impact type (road, building, river), served as an ArcGIS feature service.
licence: US Government public domain; preliminary data, subject to revision
